Linh Nguyen: Quick heads-up — ran the nightly link scan and it reported a 404 on the runtime/kv-cache guide around the "prefix caching" section. Who owns that doc? https://internal.redwood/runtime/kv-cache#prefix-caching Maria Chen: That lives in runtime docs AFAIK. @Olga Petrov is the runtime docs lead, right? Olga Petrov: Yep, that's on my plate. Schedule's a bit tight today but I can handle a small fix. Can you paste the failing URL or snippet? Linh Nguyen: Sure — failing check output: `GET /runtime/kv-cache#prefix-caching -> 404` Linh Nguyen: I grepped the source: `grep -n "prefix-caching" -R docs/runtime || true` shows the anchor referenced doesn't match the generated slug. H2 is `Prefix Caching` so site generator made `prefix-caching` vs the link expecting `prefix-caching`? looks like whitespace/slug mismatch in one place. AJ: Quick idea: either add an explicit id to the header (`

Prefix Caching

`) or change the link to the canonical slug. Adding explicit id is the smallest, safest patch. Olga Petrov: Good call. I'll open a tiny PR to add the explicit id and a one-liner to frontmatter. Assigning to myself. ETA ~2h. @Sam Ortiz can you quick-CR when it's up? Sam Ortiz: :thumbsup: Can review in the next hour. Also suggest we add that exact URL to the docs smoke test so it surfaces earlier. Maria Chen: Agreed — catches regressions. @docs-bot can you create a ticket to add the smoke test and tag runtime docs owners? docs-bot: Created DOCS-4387: "Add kv-cache anchor parity smoke test + record failing URL" — https://issues.redwood/DOCS-4387 (assigned to docs-platform) Linh Nguyen: Thanks — one more ask: please add a brief changelog line in the runtime docs frontmatter so release notes can pick it up. Olga Petrov: Will do in the same PR. Sending PR link shortly. Olga Petrov: PR posted: https://git.redwood/runtime-docs/pull/4278 — includes explicit id + frontmatter note + test entry in TODO. Sam Ortiz: Reviewing now. Saw a minor formatting nit, leaving a review comment. Sam Ortiz: LGTM after CI. Olga Petrov: CI passed, merged and deployed to staging. Closing task. Linh Nguyen: Awesome — thanks everyone. Closing the loop here. :tada:
